{{Top}}
[[File:WatTambor-AOTC.png|thumb|right|250px|Wat Tambor, Foreman of the Techno Union]]
{{Quote|Greetings, ''Foreman Fivvle''. A ''fine operation'' you are running here. In your ''debt'', the Republic is.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], to [[Fivvle]]|<ref name="In the Air">{{TCWComicCite|6.14|In the Air}}</ref>}}
The [[Guild Master/Legends|leader]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] was referred to as the '''Foreman'''. At the era of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Techno Union Foreman was [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]].

The director of the mining operations at the [[Mensix Mining Facility/Legends|Mensix Mining Facility]] was also referred to as foreman. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Chivos]], [[Donko Jen]], and [[Japer Witter]] served as foremen.
